name: Matsuno Yuki
source: Yuki's dream is to be famous. She's working to become a "sexy idol," but right now, she's on the bottom rung of the ladder. Having a natural flirtatious streak, she really likes to give Takayuki a hard time. However, it's not without rewards, she may become fond enough of him to invite him to a "private" modeling session.
